title: agents-cli effective deployment plan (approval-profile shape)
description: LOAD_BEARING_FIELDS from deployment_approval_example.py. This is the approval profile's schema, not agents-cli's native schema. Fields with no first-class agents-cli source are omitted by resolve_agents_cli_plan.py (absence, not a fabricated value). Values must stay inside the documented JCS-safe subset: str / int (not bool) / dict[str, _] / list / null. No float, no JSON bool. Honest coverage gap: several real cmd_deploy.py flags are recognized by the resolver but are NOT properties of this schema and do not enter the approval digest — see x-unmapped-cli-flags. They are named here so they are not silently uncovered; they are not mapped yet.

x-supplement-categories.notes: Policy/evidence supplements may fill honestly-absent fields. Execution-input supplements are refused — those values must come from CLI flags/manifest so a deploy-time re-resolve can bind them.

x-unmapped-cli-flags.description: Real agents-cli deploy flags this adapter recognizes (normalize_cli_flags) but does not map onto a load-bearing plan field. Reported on ResolveResult.unmapped_cli_flags_present. Not captured in the approval digest. Do not invent a mapping here; this annotation is the honest gap.

execution_relevant_unmapped.--update-env-vars: Env-var mutations at deploy time. No plan field today.
execution_relevant_unmapped.--agent-identity: Agent identity passed to deploy. No plan field today.
execution_relevant_unmapped.--port: Container/service port. No plan field today.
execution_relevant_unmapped.--build-args: Source-build arguments. No plan field today.
execution_relevant_unmapped.--cluster-name: GKE cluster. No plan field today.

control_flow_unmapped.--no-wait: Do not wait for the deploy to finish. Does not change the artifact.
control_flow_unmapped.--no-confirm-project: Skip the GCP-project click.confirm; not a deploy-approval gate.

environment.description: ABSENT in agents-cli today. No --environment on deploy.

gcp_project.description: Mapped. CLI --project, else GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT. This adapter does not call gcloud/ADC.

region.description: Mapped. CLI --region overrides manifest region. Create default: us-east1.

service_name.description: Mapped. CLI --service-name overrides manifest name. Create fallback: agent. Rejected for GKE.

source_revision.description: PARTIAL. Only CLI --image (a container URI, not a git SHA). From-source deploys have no revision.

python_version.description: ABSENT. language is a family; requires-python is a range; AGENT_VERSION is a package version.

service_account.description: Mapped. CLI --service-account. Unset means the platform default SA (not resolved here).

network_exposure.description: Mapped as a JCS-safe string-valued dict assembled from real flags. No JSON bools.

secret_policy_digest.description: Mapped. sha256 of JCS-canon({ENV: {secret, version}}) from --secrets. Identifiers only.

resource_sizing.description: Mapped. CLI --cpu/--memory/--min-instances/--max-instances/--concurrency. Create defaults from deploy/_utils.py. Absent for GKE.

eval_evidence.description: ABSENT. Evaluation is a separate agents-cli eval command family.

rollback_plan.description: ABSENT. No --rollback, no manifest key, no agents-cli rollback subcommand.

observability_requirements.description: ABSENT. Owned by the observability skill / infra single-project.
